name: Agility Tome
description: +Movement Speed - How fast you move.

name: Size Tome
description: +Size - The size of your attacks, projectiles, explosions and more.

name: Silver Tome
description: +Silver Gain - Gives you more silver from all sources.

name: Shield Tome
description: +Shield - Shield takes damage instead of losing HP before it breaks. Shield regenerates quickly after not taking damage for a while.

name: Regen Tome
description: +HP Regen - The amount of HP you regenerate per minute.

name: Projectile Speed Tome
description: +Projectile Speed - The speed of your projectiles.

name: Precision Tome
description: +Crit Chance - Chance to deal critical damage. More than 100% Crit Chance let's you Overcrit, dealing even more damage.

name: Knockback Tome
description: +Knockback - The distance you push enemies when hitting them.

name: HP Tome
description: +Max HP - Max HP

name: Evasion Tome
description: +Evasion - Evasion is the chance to avoid an attack, taking no damage.

name: Golden Tome
description: +Gold Gain - Gives you more gold from all sources.

name: Damage Tome
description: +Damage - Increases the damage of your attacks.

name: Cooldown Tome
description: Reduces the cooldown between attacks, letting you shoot and strike faster.

name: Thorns Tome
description: +Thorns - Deal damage to enemies when they attack you.

name: Quantity Tome
description: +Projectile Count - Increases the number of attacks / projectiles

name: Bloody Tome
description: +Lifesteal - Your chance to heal for 1 when you hit an enemy. Over 100% will guarantee 1 heal and give a chance to heal for a total of 2.

name: Attraction Tome
description: +Pickup Range - Pickup Range increases the distance from which you pick up xp.

name: Armor Tome
description: Increases overall Armor, reducing incoming damage.

name: Duration Tome
description: +Duration - The duration of your attacks and projectiles.
unlock: Upgrade the Axe to level 10 in a single run.

name: Luck Tome
description: +Luck - Luck increases your chances to get higher tier offers from leveling up, shrines and more.
unlock: Has a 0.01% chance to drop when killing an enemy.

name: XP Tome
description: +XP Gain - Gives you more xp from all sources.
unlock: Break 20 pots in a single run.

name: Cursed Tome
description: +Difficulty - Difficulty increases enemy quantity, health, speed & strength.
unlock: Beat any Stage Boss in under 5 minutes.

name: Chaos Tome
description: Boost a random stat.
unlock: Charge all Charge Shrines on a Tier 3 run across all three stages without leaving the charge zone.
